title: driverfile
description: DOT driver qualification file tracking for small motor carriers — read-only demo tools.
summary: DOT driver qualification file tracking for small motor carriers — read-only demo tools.
offersHint: DOT driver qualification file tracking for small motor carriers — read-only demo tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://driverfile.artificl.us/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_dq_items
toolsPreview.description: Search driver qualification file items by driver name or item type. Returns matching records with due date and status (in file, to file, missing, out of date).

toolsPreview.name: list_audit_risks
toolsPreview.description: List driver qualification file items that are missing or out of date — the items that would be findings in a DOT compliance review today. Most serious first.

toolsPreview.name: get_items_due
toolsPreview.description: List DQ file items coming due within the next N days (default 30), including medical cards, MVR reviews, and Clearinghouse queries.

toolsPreview.name: get_dq_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get the driver qualification file summary: totals for tracked items, missing from file, out of date, due in 14 days, and awaiting filing.

toolsPreview.name: export_dq_report
toolsPreview.description: Export the full driver qualification file report as CSV text (driver, item, due date, status, chase history).
